Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

I have a real answer for you this time, and it explains the silence. Your box is packed at our Brampton warehouse and the stock is reserved to it. A shipping label was created for it on the 25th, but it was cancelled before the parcel moved, so the tracking number attached to it is dead and would only have sent you to a page that never updates. That is why nothing landed in your inbox.

What is needed now is simply a fresh label on a box that is already sealed and waiting. I have put that in front of the team this morning, while they are at their desks, so it gets printed and handed to the carrier today rather than sitting another night.

The moment that label prints, the tracking comes to this address automatically and I will send it to you here as well. I will also tell you then whether the service needs a signature, so you and your wife are not guessing about being home.

Sorry you are still waiting on this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hey friends, looks like nothing got out before the weekend… hopefully today things will happen… that free bitaxe is looking good right about now lol

Looking forward to some progress,

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

You are right, nothing moved over the weekend. I looked again this morning and the box is still sitting packed at Brampton with no label on it, so there is still no tracking number that would be real.

I am not leaving that with the queue again. It is in front of the team by name this morning, first thing, with the only thing outstanding spelled out: print the label for Shop···· and hand the box to the carrier today. A colleague is picking it up now, while they are at their desks.

The second that label exists, the tracking goes to you automatically and I will send it here as well, along with whether the service needs a signature so you and your wife can plan around it.

On the gamma, I will not pretend I can hand one out, that is Georges' call and the ask is already written on your case with the stickers. Your $25 code is still live if you want to point it at something in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hey friends, just. Checked the tracking info and looks like I should be getting my pay delivery tomorrow if all goes well. Just curious if you know anything about the due balance of $46.02 to receive the package. I was unaware of any cost to me in this process. Please let me know. Thank you, all the best.

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

No, that is not yours to pay. The power supply is a free warranty replacement and it went out of our Brampton warehouse with the duties on us, so a $46.02 import fee landing on your doorstep is our problem, not yours. Please do not pay it.

I have put it straight in front of the team with the tracking number and the amount, and a colleague is on it today to get it cleared with UPS before the truck comes tomorrow. They will confirm here once UPS has it off the shipment.

If UPS does turn up tomorrow and still asks you for the money at the door, do not hand anything over, just let the driver take it back and reply to me here. Either way you will not be out of pocket for this.

Delivery is still showing tomorrow, November 6, between 2:15 and 4:15pm, and there is no signature flagged on it, so someone does not have to be standing at the door.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
